description: B-1233 (2026-11-17): a saved bindings file from a build with fewer actions is kept, not refused. The install starts with the complete default bindings file a build wrote before the Vehicle Boost action existed (12 contexts of 123 actions, the last one GunRollRight; tools/smoke-verify/fixtures/input_bindings_before_vehicle_boost.ini), which is the shape every player's file had when that action reached dev. One ordinary client launch must read it as a complete file from an older build, keep its bindings, give the new action its default and write the file out complete; before the fix the client logged 'The complete binding file is missing required rows.', ignored the saved bindings and refused every later save. The launch then loads the base Falcon 2 through the typed catalog loader and exits, only to end the run. The unit cases tagged [upgrade] in tests/test_actionmap_profile.cpp prove which bindings are kept and which shapes are still refused; this proves the real client, context names and action names. The required line names the file's own counts (123 actions, 12 contexts) and accepts any current count, so the fixture keeps proving the rule as actions and input contexts are added. It does not press a key.

input_sequence.comment: The bindings are read at startup. The catalog probe only ends the run.
Fallback only. The launch normally ends itself through --debug-exit-after-catalog-probes.

required_lines: ACTIONMAP: bindings file from an older build \(123 of \d+ actions per context, 12 of \d+ contexts\): bindings kept, new actions and contexts take their defaults, file brought up to date
forbidden_patterns: ACTIONMAP: The complete binding file is missing required rows
ACTIONMAP: The current binding file is invalid

required_counts.pattern: ACTIONMAP: bindings file from an older build
